build_transformer_attention: build a multi-head dot-product attention module with RMSNorm and configurable softmax axis
create_dot_product_attention_weights: create dot-product attention weights from query and key tensors with optional bias and mask
build_improved_transformer: build an improved transformer with cross-attention, token axis flattening, and ViT-22B tricks
build_transformer_block: build an improved transformer block with self-attention, cross-attention, and MLP layers
flatten_token_axes: flatten token axes for multi-dimensional inputs like images in transformer models
